text:
erin: quick check — onboarding question from ACME: they pushed prometheus remote_write and OTLP traces. what exact endpoints/ports/headers do we expect for private vpc customers?

sam: short answer: metrics -> our remote_write endpoint (https://metrics-ingest.redwood.com/api/v1/remote_write?team=acme), logs -> Loki push (https://logs.redwood.com/loki/api/v1/push from promtail), traces -> OTLP gRPC 4317 to ingest.redwood.internal (mTLS for private).

marta: paste of the prom config we recommend for customers:
```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: "https://metrics-ingest.redwood.com/api/v1/remote_write?team=acme"
    bearer_token: "REDACTED_TOKEN"
    queue_config:
      max_samples_per_send: 1000
      capacity: 2500
    write_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: 'process_.*'
        action: keep
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/ssl/certs/redwood-ca.pem
      insecure_skip_verify: false
```
(also add header `X-Redwood-Project: acme` if they're behind a proxy)

kevin: For OTLP traces they should point to `ingest.redwood.internal:4317` (gRPC). For private/VPC: we use mTLS and a signed client cert we provision. If they used plaintext, it'll fail with `unauthorized` in our ingress logs.

erin: where should I point the customer for dashboards? they asked for a single link to hand off to their SREs.

sam: we auto-provision a Grafana org per customer for private + dedicated. Link pattern: `https://grafana.redwood.com/d/<DASHBOARD_ID>/customer-<org>` — example: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ABCD1234/acme-overview?orgId=789. We'll create a read-only API key scoped to Viewer. I can create the key and drop it in the vault.

marta: notes on logs forwarding: promtail -> loki. If they get 403 or 401 on push, check API key and the `X-Redwood-Project` header. On our side check `k8s/ingest-loki` pod logs: `kubectl -n ingest logs deploy/ingest-loki -c http-ingest`. Typical errors: `client certificate required` (means they used plain HTTP), or `label limit exceeded` (high cardinality).

erin: user also worried about noisy alerts — which alerts should we tune for private installs?

kevin: default suggestions:
- disable or increase threshold on `HighSeriesCardinality` alert for customers with many pods
- set `scrape_interval` to 30s (default 15s) for non-critical exporters
- add `relabel_configs` to drop container-specific labels: `container_id`, `pod_ip` in the remote_write stage
- for logs, set `max_line_size` and `pipeline_stages` in promtail to truncate huge entries

ops-bot: Created Grafana org `acme` and read-only key `r_acme_ro_7XN` (ttl 30d) — dropped creation note to vault path `secret/acme/grafana/ro_key`.

erin: perfect — thanks. i'll send these snippets to the customer and ask them to rotate the example token. sam: can you open a tiny PR to our docs with the prom snippet? marta: want to review the wording.

sam: yup i'll open PR #3128 and ping @marta for review. small nit: header key name is `X-Redwood-Project` not `X-Redwood-Team`.

marta: LGTM on the plan, i'll review the PR in the morning. :thumbsup: 

kevin: if they still fail, tell them to paste the `ingest-gateway` request id (x-request-id) from their client and we'll grep it in `ingest` logs.

erin: thanks everyone — closing this thread after PR lands. :white_check_mark:
